dynasty.bounty.acquire_wheat.title: Acquire - Wheat
dynasty.bounty.acquire_wheat.desc: Hand in 16 wheat. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used; armour, offhand and curios are untouched, and nothing is taken unless the full amount is present.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_carrot.title: Acquire - Carrots
dynasty.bounty.acquire_carrot.desc: Hand in 16 carrots. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used; nothing is taken unless the full amount is present.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_potato.title: Acquire - Potatoes
dynasty.bounty.acquire_potato.desc: Hand in 16 potatoes. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used; nothing is taken unless the full amount is present.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_brown_mushroom.de: Hand in 12 brown mushrooms. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_string.title: Acquire - String
dynasty.bounty.acquire_string.desc: Hand in 16 string. Spiders and cave spiders drop it; only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_leather.title: Acquire - Leather
dynasty.bounty.acquire_leather.desc: Hand in 8 leather. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_paper.title: Acquire - Paper
dynasty.bounty.acquire_paper.desc: Hand in 16 paper, crafted from sugar cane. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_bamboo.title: Acquire - Bamboo
dynasty.bounty.acquire_bamboo.desc: Hand in 16 bamboo from jungles or panda areas. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_cobblestone.title: Acquire - Cobblestone
dynasty.bounty.acquire_cobblestone.desc: Hand in 32 cobblestone, a common mining by-product. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_logs.title: Acquire - Logs
dynasty.bounty.acquire_logs.desc: Hand in 32 logs of any type (matched by the vanilla logs tag). Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_zombie.title: Hunt - Zombies
dynasty.bounty.hunt_zombie.desc: Kill 8 zombies yourself after accepting. Only your own kills count (including arrows you fired); pet kills, environmental deaths and other players' kills do not.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_skeleton.title: Hunt - Skeletons
dynasty.bounty.hunt_skeleton.desc: Kill 8 skeletons yourself after accepting. Only your own kills count (including your arrows); pets and environmental deaths do not.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_spider.title: Hunt - Spiders
dynasty.bounty.hunt_spider.desc: Kill 6 spiders yourself after accepting. Kills made before accepting are never counted retroactively.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_creeper.title: Hunt - Creepers
dynasty.bounty.hunt_creeper.desc: Kill 4 creepers yourself after accepting. Only your own kills count (including your arrows); pets and other players do not.
dynasty.bounty.explore_celestial.title: Survey - Celestial Dynasty
dynasty.bounty.explore_celestial.desc: Enter the Celestial Dynasty yourself after accepting. If you are already inside when you accept, it completes on the next server check (about 2 seconds).
dynasty.bounty.explore_underworld.title: Survey - Underworld
dynasty.bounty.explore_underworld.desc: Enter the Underworld yourself after accepting. If you are already inside, it completes on the next server check (about 2 seconds).
dynasty.bounty.explore_jiuxiao.title: Survey - Nine-Heaven Realm
dynasty.bounty.explore_jiuxiao.desc: Enter the Nine-Heaven Realm yourself after accepting. Requires the 'Reach the Nine Heavens' advancement first, otherwise this offer stays locked.
dynasty.bounty.explore_dragon_palace.des: Enter the Dragon Palace yourself after accepting. Requires the 'Into the Dragon Palace' advancement first; bring water breathing.

tooltip.dynasty.school.zhenyue_blade: Main-hand use: guard up to 2s, block 50% of front-facing blockable damage; 6s cooldown after guarding. Blocking a hostile stores one +35% full-strength blade hit for 3s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.zhenguan_mirror: +4 armour. Guard damage +1.6% per toughness point (max +200%); Mountain-Ward counter window extends to 6s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.huben_bracer: +15% knockback resistance, +12% Guard damage; counters push mobs away or slow bosses I for 2s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.liuyun_sword: Land three full-strength melee hits on one enemy within 3s between hits; the third deals +50% and resets the chain. Weak hits, target changes or weapon swaps reset it.
tooltip.dynasty.school.liancheng_tassel: +6% attack speed, +16% Sword damage; Flowing-Cloud chain window extends to 5s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.tayun_pendant: +4% speed, +12% Sword damage; Flowing-Cloud finishers grant Swift Wind I for 2s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.zhuxing_bow: Arrow base damage ×2+30. A fully drawn hit marks one enemy for 8s; a second fully drawn hit on it consumes the mark for +40% damage. Hitting another enemy replaces the mark; no homing or wall piercing.
tooltip.dynasty.school.guanxing_pendant: +40 health, +10% Bow damage (+25% against glowing targets); Star-Chasing marks make targets glow for 3s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.mingxian_ring: +3 armour, +12% Bow damage; consuming a mark slows I for 2s (1s on bosses).
tooltip.dynasty.school.chiling_brush: Main-hand use: slow up to 8 visible hostiles within 5 blocks, II for 3s (bosses I for 1s); 8s cooldown. Hold still while using for 2s to store one +50% full-strength brush hit for 4s. Moving or releasing early cancels charging.
tooltip.dynasty.school.sitian_seal: +40 health, +25% Edict damage; Edict slow lasts 2s longer (1s on bosses).
tooltip.dynasty.school.dingfeng_silk: +3 armour, +15% Edict damage; stationary Edict charging adds 50% knockback resistance. Damage bonus does not require charging.
message.dynasty.school.guard_ready: Counter ready: next full-strength Mountain-Ward hit +35%
message.dynasty.school.star_marked: Star mark: land another fully drawn shot within 8s
message.dynasty.school.edict_cast: Edict cast: hold use and stand still for 2s
message.dynasty.school.edict_ready: Edict ready: next full-strength brush hit +50% within 4s
